text:
michelle: Quick sync — Polaris + LumenGrid joint workshop final run-of-show. Wed 10:00-11:30 PT. Need AV + demo fallbacks + swag pickup plan.
raj: got it. main ask: confirm speaker order and who needs laptop HDMI.
olivia: i'll take speaker coordination. michelle can you paste the speaker list?
michelle: Speakers: James (Polaris) intro 10:05, Ethan (Redwood) live demo 10:20, Sara (LumenGrid) use-case 10:40, Panel 11:00. 10 min talks, 15 min demo.
ethan: for the live demo i'll need GPU node with local model (A100 eq) and internet for Hosted Redwood API fallback if local fails.
sara (LumenGrid): we can bring a laptop + adapter, but confirm power banks for streaming? last time we ran low.
james (Polaris): are we doing the cross-cloud marketplace announcement slide at 10:00 or at the panel? prefer at start.
michelle: announcement will be 10:00 (30s) then quick hello from partners. good call.
tess (Events Ops): swag plan: 200 sticker packs, 50 tees, 30 power banks (labelled Polaris+Redwood). where to ship?
michelle: ship to venue c/o Tess — i'll DM the courier info. customs note: tees go via international courier, need HS code.
raj: AV checklist: projector, HDMI->USB-C adapters (4), lav mics (3), ethernet drop, laptop HDMI passthrough. backup: meeting room wifi + local hotspot.
ethan: demo fallback plan (short):
```
# local fallback start
git clone https://github.com/redwood-inference/demo-playbook
cd demo-playbook
./scripts/run-local.sh --model polaris-mini --port 8080
# if model fails: use hosted api fallback (env REDWOOD_API_KEY)
```
olivia: scheduling: can we do a tech-check Tuesday 4pm PT with all speakers? need 30 min.
james (Polaris): Tuesday 4pm works for me. sara yes too.
sara (LumenGrid): confirmed. bring the LumenGrid HDMI dongle.
tess (Events Ops): swag pickup window: Wed 8:30-9:30am at loading dock. michelle i'll add you to the vendor access list.
michelle: who has booth passes? i need names to add to list.
raj: michelle, add: michelle, raj, olivia, ethan, james, sara. that's 6. tess: are vendor + speaker passes separate?
tess (Events Ops): speaker passes are on the guest list; vendor passes for staffing will be separate. I'll send the QR codes by Tue EOD.
michelle: logistics note — demo machine will need Docker 24+, NVIDIA drivers 535+, >=32GB RAM. Ethan confirm container image size so we can pre-pull.
ethan: image is ~6.2GB. i'll push a lean image tag "demo-slim" and share pull command.
james (Polaris): can we get a short rehearsal order? i'd like to rehearse the marketplace slide timing with you.
olivia: rehearsal agenda: 5m setup, 10m announcement + intros, 20m demo runthrough, 10m backup failover test, 10m Q&A flow. total 55m.
michelle: perfect. olivia please send calendar invite for Tue 4pm and include runbook doc link.
deploy-bot: calendar invite created: "Polaris x LumenGrid Workshop — Tech Check" Tue 16:00 PT.
raj: one more — networking table ask: can we have 1 small table near booth for conversation + 2 chairs? tess?
tess (Events Ops): yes we can reserve a table. i'll confirm layout with venue and send sightline notes.
sara (LumenGrid): for swag: can you confirm artwork deadline? we need logo lockup for power banks by Thu EOD.
michelle: logo lockup due Thu EOD — i'll route logos today.
james (Polaris): last thing — demo captioning? we should run auto-captions for accessibility. any preferences?
olivia: we'll enable live captions via venue AV and also add stitched transcript in followup.
michelle: thanks all — will DM shipping labels and post updated runbook here after rehearsal. :thumbsup:
